standard: BetInsight Social Preview v3 — Verified Original Transparent Logo & Premium Football

betinsight.only_permitted_processing: Crop near-invisible external transparency; never redraw/recolor logo or its lettering.

betinsight_fullsize_reference.rule: Reference candidate for larger layouts; verify visually against the approved brand before choosing it.

time_clash.rule: Approved clean 1024px wordmark. Keep pixels untouched; downscale only. Follow time-clash/assets/branding/README.md and time-clash-branding-guard.yml.

time_clash_seal.rule: Secondary element only, not a substitute for the approved TIME CLASH wordmark.

image_policy.social_cache_note: Use distinct image filenames per post and per meaningful revision.

INSERAT + URL.meaning: Review the already published external ad/post, create accurate DE + target-language documentation on BetInsight website, create its own OG preview from the approved brand assets, insert metadata and UTM attribution, test page and preview. Do not claim publication until GitHub deployment is verified.

master_result_confirmation.desired_trigger: After authorized Master Backoffice confirmation of WON/LOST/VOID, generate matching public preview, update localized article, preserve audit history; never before final confirmation.
master_result_confirmation.status: NOT YET AUTOMATED: current database RPC writes betinsight_tip_results/history but does not trigger static-page or image generation.

pilot.context: Initial Flipboard BetInsight magazine item linked to English Crystal Palace vs Manchester City tip review
pilot.source_status: GitHub page verified; flip.it shortlink destination not independently resolvable from connector.

status: Brand paths and operating rule documented in the GitHub repository; fully automatic social-image generation/publication is a separate implementation task.

visual_style.key_visual: Sharp licensed real soccer ball and grass photograph in foreground, dramatic midnight-blue editorial sports cover with defocused stadium feel. Never invented player faces, team marks or BetInsight symbols.
visual_style.sports_photo_licensing: Use BetInsight-owned or appropriately licensed stadium and ball imagery; do not fabricate real-player photos or paste official club crests, league emblems, logos or sponsor branding without rights.
visual_style.typography: Large legible real team names; prominent exact score and date; compact status WON/LOST/VOID; legible even as small social card.
visual_style.layout: Original logo top-left, match details left, sharp ball + wet grass predominantly right. Balanced with clear visual hierarchy and enough safe margins for social crawlers.
visual_style.approved_original_logo_rule: Brand mark must be physically composited from ORIGINAL approved GitHub asset bytes. NEVER ask an AI image generator to draw, reproduce, interpret, or modify the BetInsight or TIME CLASH logo; an image model's representation is not the original.
visual_style.fallback_rule: If original logo or licensed photo asset is unavailable, STOP and report an error. Never substitute a generic or hallucinated brand mark.
visual_style.identity_consistency: Replace only actual match names, final score, status, date, category; no guessed match facts. For public RESULT cards require confirmed result and display correct BetInsight WIN/LOSS (not necessarily home-team outcome).
visual_style.versioning: On visual changes change the OG image filename (v2, v3) so social crawlers fetch the update.

implementation.automated_backoffice_result_previews: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED. Do not claim automatic result cards from Master confirmation.
implementation.keyword_rule: Use the published ad link to prepare a bilingual report and ORIGINAL-BRAND image. Do not claim automation from a chat message alone; perform GitHub publish and validate.

dynamic_result_pages.authorisation: Only confirmed and public tipped results
dynamic_result_pages.individual_story: Static verified first pilot; later Supabase cached API-Football events

seo_image_standard.label: BetInsight Bild- und Suchmaschinen-Metadaten

original_template.render_rule: Never place a second logo on an already-branded template; do not redraw, recolor or replace existing logo.

image_file.filename: Descriptive, unique per tip and version, no keyword stuffing.

file_metadata.JPEG: Embed real EXIF ImageDescription, Artist, Copyright and Software where applicable. Never invent authorship or rights.
file_metadata.PNG: Use PNG tEXt/iTXt chunks Title, Description, Author, Copyright and Source when supported; keep master template unmodified.
file_metadata.google_caveat: Embedded EXIF/IPTC/XMP/PNG metadata alone does not establish Google indexing or search rankings; page-level signals matter.

text_fields: Factual image description incl. result, overall tip status, number of legs
BetInsight Club as publisher, not automatically as photographer/copyright-holder
Actual licensed image asset credit where required
image_file.accessibility: Per-report descriptive alt text in the page HTML; not visible printed SEO text across the image.

page.robots: index,follow,max-image-preview:large only for confirmed public reports
page.title: unique search title for match(es), result, BetInsight
page.description: human, factual summary explaining final outcome; no guaranteed winnings or fabricated events
page.critical: Pure client-side mutations of /de/tipps/bericht/?id=... do not reliably expose per-tip metadata to Flipboard/Google. Build and host a unique static/server-rendered URL for each confirmed result before social distribution.
page.structured_data_claim: Use truthful Article/ImageObject schema; do not add SportsEvent claims or review ratings without accurate data.

seo_image_standard.match_story: Use verified API-Football match events and original match source links. Combinations: each leg, winning/losing condition, crucial moments and short overall explanation. Do not invent unavailable details.
seo_image_standard.publishing_gate: No social publishing until generated image exists, public URL responds, static HTML contains its own correct meta tags and real preview has been checked.
seo_image_standard.status: DOCUMENTED; not an indication that the automatic master-backoffice event-to-per-tip-OG pipeline is live.

multi_language_release_policy.note: NL/ZH are NOT currently supported on tip-report pages. Expand only after dedicated UI+editorial+OG implementations.
per_tip_required: unique indexable HTML route per locale
translated title/description, match narrative, key events and market labels
translated text on the image, never redraw pre-embedded original logo
separate image metadata and og:image per locale
localized canonical and bidirectional hreflang x-default
same original statistical report in that language with same values and formulas
official source link, evidence and transparency disclaimer
multi_language_release_policy.batch_gate: exactly 5 confirmed tip IDs x 6 languages = 30 indexable HTML pages and 30 individual localized image files; CI fails hard on any missing output; no partial block release
multi_language_release_policy.no_fake_translation: Do not substitute German or English reports for Spanish/Portuguese/Italian/French; preserve actual names, events, scores, original odds, units and game selection.

portuguese_policy.text_rule: Native European Portuguese vocabulary, grammar and conventions in image, match commentary, original result report, headings, buttons and SEO.
portuguese_policy.hard_gate: CI must fail when any published PT report uses pt-BR or Portuguese (Brasil). No Brazil flag as language marker.

navigation_rule.homepage_selection: Use persistent betinsight_language locale from main site for INTERNAL navigation.
navigation_rule.result_pages: No duplicate language switch on SEO result pages; keep six unique paths /de/,/en/,/es/,/pt/,/it/,/fr/ and hreflang in head.
navigation_rule.external_share: Do NOT redirect external Flipboard/Facebook/crawler visitors away from language specified in shared URL.

multi_language_release_policy.visual_rule: Every status badge must be precisely centered in its colored frame with >14px horizontal safety padding; verified in all six languages; no translated text crossing borders.
multi_language_release_policy.image_version_rule: Use distinct versioned image URLs when changing the image to bypass social media caches.
